item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 30/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Upper-air disturbances will bring showers to the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. With the northeast monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise gradually over the region. Under the influence of a humid southerly airstream, it will be misty in the morning and at night over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to bring slightly cooler weather to Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
